feat: improve accessibility across UI components (#2551)

* feat: improve accessibility across UI components

Enhance WCAG 2.1 compliance by adding proper ARIA attributes and semantic HTML across core UI components.

Key improvements:
- Button: Add aria-busy and aria-disabled states for loading/disabled buttons
- Input: Add aria-invalid and aria-describedby for error handling
- Navbar: Add semantic nav element, aria-current for active page, aria-hidden for decorative icons
- Dialog: Fix close button to use aria-label instead of incorrect aria-description
- Pagination: Add aria-hidden="true" to decorative elements
- PasswordInput: Move aria-label from icon to button, mark icons as aria-hidden
- Switch: Fix aria-labelledby to properly connect label and control
- i18n: Add HEADER_MAIN_NAVIGATION translation key

These changes improve screen reader experience and keyboard navigation without affecting visual presentation or existing functionality.

* fix(logs-terminal): wrap toolbar on mobile portrait to prevent overflow

- Add flex-wrap and vertical gap (gy-2) on the toolbar row so the
  follow/wrap-lines/max-lines controls stack instead of overflowing
  the card on narrow (portrait) mobile viewports.
- Switch each column to col-12 col-md-auto so controls take full
  width on mobile and inline width from md breakpoint up.
- Remove the inconsistent mt-1 (on the switches) and mb-2 (on the
  input-group) margins that caused vertical misalignment between
  the wrap-lines switch and the max-lines input group; alignment is
  now handled uniformly by align-items-center + gy-2 on the row.

* Refactor logs-terminal component layout and styles

* fix(logs-terminal): address CodeRabbit review feedback and refine responsive layout

- Place 'Follow logs' and 'Wrap lines' switches side-by-side on mobile (col-6) and inline on desktop (col-md-auto).
- Align 'Max lines' input to the right on desktop (ms-md-auto) while stacking on mobile (col-12).
- Fix a11y: replace span with label and associate id/htmlFor and aria-label with the input.
- Address CodeRabbit feedback: truncate maxLines to integer with Math.trunc and add step={1}.
- Address CodeRabbit feedback: keep input controlled using value={maxLines} to stay synchronized.

* feat: improve accessibility across UI components

Enhance WCAG 2.1 compliance by adding proper ARIA attributes and semantic HTML across core UI components.

- Button: Add aria-busy and aria-disabled states for loading/disabled buttons
- Input: Add aria-invalid and aria-describedby for error handling
- Navbar: Add semantic nav element, aria-current for active page, aria-hidden for decorative icons
- Dialog: Fix close button to use aria-label instead of incorrect aria-description
- Pagination: Add aria-hidden="true" to decorative elements
- PasswordInput: Move aria-label from icon to button, mark icons as aria-hidden
- Switch: Fix aria-labelledby to properly connect label and control
- i18n: Add HEADER_MAIN_NAVIGATION translation key

These changes improve screen reader experience and keyboard navigation without affecting visual presentation or existing functionality.

feat: improve accessibility across UI components (#2551)

* feat: improve accessibility across UI components

Enhance WCAG 2.1 compliance by adding proper ARIA attributes and semantic HTML across core UI components.

Key improvements:
- Button: Add aria-busy and aria-disabled states for loading/disabled buttons
- Input: Add aria-invalid and aria-describedby for error handling
- Navbar: Add semantic nav element, aria-current for active page, aria-hidden for decorative icons
- Dialog: Fix close button to use aria-label instead of incorrect aria-description
- Pagination: Add aria-hidden="true" to decorative elements
- PasswordInput: Move aria-label from icon to button, mark icons as aria-hidden
- Switch: Fix aria-labelledby to properly connect label and control
- i18n: Add HEADER_MAIN_NAVIGATION translation key

These changes improve screen reader experience and keyboard navigation without affecting visual presentation or existing functionality.

Fix/logs terminal mobile overflow (#2641)

* fix(logs-terminal): wrap toolbar on mobile portrait to prevent overflow

- Add flex-wrap and vertical gap (gy-2) on the toolbar row so the
  follow/wrap-lines/max-lines controls stack instead of overflowing
  the card on narrow (portrait) mobile viewports.
- Switch each column to col-12 col-md-auto so controls take full
  width on mobile and inline width from md breakpoint up.
- Remove the inconsistent mt-1 (on the switches) and mb-2 (on the
  input-group) margins that caused vertical misalignment between
  the wrap-lines switch and the max-lines input group; alignment is
  now handled uniformly by align-items-center + gy-2 on the row.

* Refactor logs-terminal component layout and styles

* fix(logs-terminal): address CodeRabbit review feedback and refine responsive layout

- Place 'Follow logs' and 'Wrap lines' switches side-by-side on mobile (col-6) and inline on desktop (col-md-auto).
- Align 'Max lines' input to the right on desktop (ms-md-auto) while stacking on mobile (col-12).
- Fix a11y: replace span with label and associate id/htmlFor and aria-label with the input.
- Address CodeRabbit feedback: truncate maxLines to integer with Math.trunc and add step={1}.
- Address CodeRabbit feedback: keep input controlled using value={maxLines} to stay synchronized.
